title: Housecall Pro Pricing (2026): Plans by Team Size
summary: Housecall Pro pricing ranges from $99 to $249 monthly across four tiers, with add-on costs for extra users. See what's included in each plan.
body_markdown:
## Hidden costs and usage limits


Four things add to the monthly bill beyond the plan price. They are add-ons sold separately, the card processing rate, features locked to higher tiers, and contract terms the pricing page may not state. Each one needs a line in your quote.


### Add-ons priced separately


Once a shop on Essentials wants follow-up messaging, it is no longer paying the Essentials price. Campaigns, the add-on for sending marketing emails and texts to past customers, costs extra on top of the plan.


Check the pricing page for each add-on you expect to use, and write the price next to it. If the page lists a feature without a price, you can't assume it comes with the plan.


### Housecall Pro payment processing fees


Every card payment taken through Housecall Pro carries a percentage rate. That rate doesn't appear in the subscription line, so it never shows up when you compare plan prices. It grows with your invoicing volume.


On the same plan, a busy shop pays more in processing than a slow one, so estimate your monthly card revenue and multiply it by the published rate. Then check whether the rate changes by tier or by payment method, such as card-on-file versus in-person.


### Feature and usage limits by tier


The risk isn't the plan you're quoting. It's the feature you assumed came with the plan and find missing, usually after you've started setup.


Some features sit on higher tiers only. Go through the tier comparison and mark each feature your crew needs. Any feature that appears only on a higher tier means your real plan is that tier.


> The risk isn't the plan you're quoting. It's the feature you assumed came with the plan and find missing, usually after you've started setup.


Count everyone who needs a login, including office staff and seasonal techs, because extra users are also priced per seat and each additional seat raises the monthly total.


### Housecall Pro contract and cancellation terms


Where the pricing page is silent, treat the answer as unknown. That covers setup or onboarding fees, whether billing is monthly or annual, how renewal works, and what happens to your data and your processing arrangement if you leave.


Ask sales to confirm each in an email, not on a call. A written answer is something you can point to later. A verbal one isn't.


Once you've priced and confirmed those four items, add them to the user-based total. The result is the number you would actually pay each month.
